newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - Jan 31.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following major business stories on Jan. 31:

WASHINGTON - Federal regulators said they plan to fine Channel 5 in Washington $10,000 for violating rules that govern ads that air during children's shows. The station said it would not contest the fine.

WASHINGTON - Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan, arguing that the consumer price index isn't accurate enough, proposed the creation of a new national commission to decide annual cost-of-living adjustments in federal benefits and taxes.
WASHINGTON - As computer networks become widespread and essential to companies and government agencies, they also have become tempting targets for cyber saboteurs.
NEW YORK - For a record 16th straight quarter, corporate earnings have exceeded expectations more often than not, proving many experts and analysts wrong.
